name: Star-Charged reduces the cooldown of Aspects by 5 seconds (#1880)
contract: Star-Charged 500608 (Spell.dbc, SpellFamilyName 32, passive) carries one effect: SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) with EffectMiscValue 11 = SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN, EffectBasePoints -5001 with DieSides 1 resolving to -5000 ms, and EffectSpellClassMask word2 0x800. That bit is carried by every Aspect parent: Stars 800510 (803887 and 803888 for ranks 2-3), Cosmos 801123, Warden 801128, Goddess 802203, Huntress 805356 and Moonwell 574360 (all Attributes 0x81050000, category 235, RecoveryTime and/or CategoryRecoveryTime 10000). The tooltip reads 'Reduces the cooldown of your Aspects by $/1000;s1 sec.' Native path only: Player::AddSpellAndCategoryCooldowns applies Player::ApplySpellMod(SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN) to both the spell and the category recovery time (Player.cpp, the two calls around 'Now we have cooldown data'), and a flat modifier is added as is. The spell_modifier metric applies the player's SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN modifiers (op 11) for the given spell id to a base of 10000 through Player::ApplySpellMod, the same call the cooldown code makes. The control must read 10000 unchanged, the talented fixture 5000. Not asserted: the resulting live cooldown after casting an Aspect, because the harness cast path for Aspects depends on module proc state; the modifier consumer is the stock code quoted above.
